csv_project_name: Inspection for Local Bridge Inspection Services District 6
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Pennsylvania , Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a Inspection for Local Bridge Inspection Services District 6, NBIS Bridge Inspection of eligible Local County owned bridges and select railroad owned bridges in District 6-0. Services will include any Bridge Inspection Tasks outlined in Publication 238.

title: Inspection for Local Bridge Inspection Services District 6
short_description: Bridge inspection services for local and selected railroad-owned bridges in Pennsylvania District 6.
project_scope: Consultant services for NBIS bridge inspection of eligible local county-owned bridges and selected railroad-owned bridges in PennDOT District 6-0. Services include bridge inspection tasks outlined in Publication 238. The notice does not specify the number of bridges, bridge lengths, spans, or structural types.
services: Bridge inspection services, NBIS inspections, and related bridge inspection tasks under Publication 238; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge-related assignment, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- Scope is limited to inspection services rather than design or structural concept development.
- No specific complex, long-span, or architecturally demanding bridge structures are identified.
- Includes selected railroad-owned bridges, but no technical details are provided.
- Could be of some interest as checking/inspection work, but overall strategic fit is moderate to low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice only mentions a contract value of 3500000 USD for consultant inspection services, not construction works. Specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the notice. Requested disciplines: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
